title: Introduce Router struct to go_http_server
description: Brownfield Go refactor: encapsulate route registration in a Router struct, keeping the existing ListItems handler unchanged.

task_spec.prompt:
Add a Router struct to internal/handler/items.go. All existing tests must still pass.

  type Router struct { mux *http.ServeMux }

  func NewRouter() *Router
    — creates a new http.ServeMux
    — registers GET /items -> ListItems on the mux
    — returns the Router

  func (rt *Router) ServeHTTP(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request)
    — delegates to rt.mux.ServeHTTP

Update cmd/server/main.go to use:
  rt := handler.NewRouter()
  http.ListenAndServe(":8080", rt)

Do not modify ListItems or the existing test.
Add at least 3 tests for the Router (e.g. GET /items returns 200, unknown path returns 404, Router implements http.Handler).
All 1 existing fixture tests must still pass.
Run: go test ./...
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` to confirm no regressions from your refactor. Also review the code you changed — any remaining duplication, long functions, or unclear names to clean up?
Final pass: run `go test ./...` and confirm everything is green. Give me a one-line summary of what changed.
